emily: FYI PR #5234 landed a draft migration guide for the new JSON envelope shape. Moving examples from ad-hoc outputs to a top-level envelope. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234 :memo:

jason: Thanks. I'll sync the JS SDK snippets tonight. Any guidance on naming the helper? unwrapEnvelope vs decodeEnvelope?

sophia: We standardized on `unwrap_envelope` in Python and `unwrapEnvelope` in JS to keep casing idiomatic. The guide should show both.
followups:
ravi: Please include a short guardrail snippet: validate meta.parse_version and fallback to legacy parser when absent. Also add a perf note: envelope variance can reduce prefix cache hit rate, mention batching implications.

emily: Action items:
- sophia: add nullable-array example and parse-fallback code
- jason: update JS snippets in /docs/sdk/js/examples and add a migration note about naming
- matt: add canonical tool-calling example inside envelope.result
- ravi: add guardrail paragraph and caching blurb

docs-bot: link-checker: scanned PR #5234 1 warnings about trailing slashes; 0 broken links after sophia's link fix.
